title: Host-backed Core.FS through canonical ABI-v5 adapters
body:
The read-only FS authority audit and validated `complete-v0-4-corelib-runtime-contracts` OpenSpec change are complete. Production implementation has not begun. The required design is `Core.FS` only, using manifest-owned ABI-v5 canonical runtime adapters on Linux x86-64, macOS arm64, and Windows x86-64. Legacy `System.FS`, `beskid_host` dispatch, heuristic results, aliases, fallbacks, and fabricated success must be removed. The contract adds real `Result<Unit, E>`, typed `BeskidFsStatus`, and `Exists -> Result<bool, FsError>` so absence is successful false while adapter failure is an error.

## Sequencing

Blocked on fresh 61/61 Corelib, collection storage, generic-unit Result support, and the typed adapter status channel.

**Linear:** [CYB-185](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-185/v04-implement-canonical-host-backed-corefs)

subtasks.text: Implement Result<Unit,E> and typed FS status channel
Implement three-target canonical adapters and purge System.FS
